'''Stonerays''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of flying reptavian [[Diet/Legends|carnivores]] native to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Living in [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] and [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]], they used their taloned tails to disembowel their prey. Seeing them hunt in this way was especially horrifying at night under the red glow of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]] which caused the stone rays to appear as if covered in blood.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Stonerays first appear in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]]. The game uses for stonerays the same model as for the [[Bogstalker]]s.
